dessin: A role card: one landscape flat pale rectangle #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline. Across the top of the card, a header band about one quarter of the card height, separated from the body by one thin horizontal ink line; the header band is completely empty, plain pale color, nothing drawn in it. In the body below the line, exactly two men standing side by side and slightly apart, full-body flat solid ink #23281F silhouettes like the scale figures of an architect's elevation: two adult men, short hair, trousers, arms along the body, both facing the viewer, both standing on one short thin horizontal ground line. No other person, no object, nothing else in the card.
